extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and on the Web Store.

extDescription.message: Live bilingual captions for any tab: the original line and its translation, from your own Gemini or Deepgram + DeepL key.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in Chrome and on the Web Store. Must stay under 132 characters.

uiLanguage.description: BCP-47 tag for THIS catalogue's language, used for the document lang attribute. Translators: set it to your own locale, not to a translation of the word.

loadingSettings.description: Shown while the popup or options page reads stored settings.

openOptions.description: Button in the popup that opens the options page.

keyStorageNote.message: API keys are kept only in this device's local Chrome storage.
keyStorageNote.description: Reassurance shown at the bottom of the popup and options page.

statusIdle.description: Popup status pill: no captioning session is running.

statusStarting.description: Popup status pill: a session is being established.

statusRunning.description: Popup status pill: captions are being produced.

statusRetry.description: Popup status pill: the session failed and must be restarted.

statusTranslationFailed.description: Popup status pill: captions continue but translation is failing.

statusTranslationDisabled.description: Popup status pill: translation gave up after repeated failures.

providerHeading.description: Heading of the provider section in the popup and options page.

transcriberLabel.description: Label for the dropdown that picks the speech provider.

translatorLabel.description: Label for the dropdown that picks the translation provider.

keysConfigured.description: Popup line telling the user the selected provider has its key.

keysMissing.description: Popup line telling the user the selected provider has no key yet.

resetApiKey.description: Link that reveals a configured API Key field so it can be replaced.

increaseCaptionFont.message: Increase original and translation font sizes
increaseCaptionFont.description: Caption toolbar action that increases both font sizes.

decreaseCaptionFont.message: Decrease original and translation font sizes
decreaseCaptionFont.description: Caption toolbar action that decreases both font sizes.

increaseCaptionBackground.description: Caption toolbar action that increases background opacity.

decreaseCaptionBackground.description: Caption toolbar action that decreases background opacity.

providerSignupLink.description: Link under a provider dropdown. $1 is the provider's sign-up domain.

geminiGuideLink.message: How to create a Gemini API key
geminiGuideLink.description: Link from the popup to the first-use Gemini API key guide.

onboardingPageTitle.message: Create a Gemini API key | Bilingual Live Captions
onboardingPageTitle.description: Browser tab title for the Gemini onboarding guide.

onboardingEyebrow.description: Small heading above the onboarding title.

onboardingTitle.description: Main heading of the onboarding guide.

onboardingSubtitle.message: Follow these four steps in Google AI Studio, then paste the key into Bilingual Live Captions.
onboardingSubtitle.description: Introductory copy for the onboarding guide.

onboardingOpenAiStudio.description: Button that opens the Google AI Studio API Keys page.

onboardingStepSignInTitle.message: Sign in to Google AI Studio

onboardingStepSignInBody.message: Open the API Keys page and sign in with your Google Account. If Google shows its terms, review and accept them before continuing.

onboardingStepCreateTitle.message: Use an existing key or create one

onboardingStepCreateBody.message: New users may already have a project and key. If a key is listed, you can skip to step 4. Otherwise, select Create API key.

onboardingStepProjectTitle.message: Name the key and choose a project

onboardingStepProjectBody.message: Name it “Bilingual Live Captions”, choose an imported project, and select Create key. If no project is available, use Import projects first.

onboardingStepCopyTitle.message: Copy the key and set it in the extension

onboardingStepCopyBody.message: Select the Copy icon beside the key. Open the extension popup, paste it into Gemini API Key, then select Set.

onboardingCreateButtonAlt.message: Google AI Studio API Keys page with the Create API key button highlighted.
onboardingCreateButtonAlt.description: Alternative text for the create-button screenshot.

onboardingCreateDialogAlt.message: Create a new key dialog with the key name, project, and Create key button highlighted.
onboardingCreateDialogAlt.description: Alternative text for the create-dialog screenshot.

onboardingCopyKeyAlt.message: Google AI Studio key list with the Copy icon highlighted.
onboardingCopyKeyAlt.description: Alternative text for the copy-key screenshot.

onboardingNotesLabel.description: Accessible label for the onboarding notes section.

onboardingSecurityBody.message: Never share or post your API key. If it is exposed, delete it in AI Studio and create a replacement. The extension keeps it in local Chrome storage on this device.

onboardingBillingBody.message: AI Studio offers a limited free tier. You only need Set up billing if you choose paid usage or need higher limits.

languageHeading.description: Heading of the language section in the popup.

autoDetect.description: The only source-language option in Gemini mode, which detects it itself.

startCaptions.description: Main popup button when no session is running.

stopCaptions.description: Main popup button while a session is running.

working.description: Main popup button while a start or stop request is in flight.

sizeHeading.description: Heading of the font-size and text-color section in the popup.

originalFontSizeLabel.description: Slider label for the source-language font size.

translationFontSizeLabel.description: Slider label for the translated-language font size.

originalTextColorLabel.description: Color picker label for the source-language caption text.

translationTextColorLabel.description: Color picker label for the translated-language caption text.

colorCodeLabel.description: Accessible label for a caption color's hexadecimal text input. $1 is the color field label.

resetTextColors.description: Button that restores both caption text colors.

layoutHeading.description: Heading of the layout section in the popup.

showMoreSettings.description: Summary that reveals the caption style and layout settings in the popup.

clearCaptions.description: Accessible label for the button that clears the current caption window.

maxLineWidthLabel.description: Slider label for the widest a caption row may be cut.

minLineWidthLabel.description: Slider label for the shortest a caption row may stay before merging.

backgroundOpacityLabel.description: Slider label for how opaque the caption box background is.

unitColumns.description: Unit appended to the line-length sliders. Counted in character widths: CJK counts as two. Keep the leading space.

openSidePanel.description: Accessible label for the caption overlay Side Panel button.

captionOverlayTitle.description: Title shown in the floating caption toolbar.

sidePanelTitle.description: Heading in the Chrome Side Panel.

enableAutoScroll.description: Button that resumes following the latest Side Panel caption.

disableAutoScroll.description: Button that pauses following the latest Side Panel caption.

sidePanelWaiting.message: Start captions from the extension popup to see them here.
sidePanelWaiting.description: Side Panel empty state when there is no live session.

sidePanelInactive.message: Captions are now floating on the webpage. Chrome 116 may require you to close this panel manually.
sidePanelInactive.description: Side Panel notice after switching back to the floating overlay.

sidePanelEmpty.description: Side Panel empty state while a session is active.

privacyGemini.message: Once started, the tab's audio is sent to Google Gemini, which returns both the original text and the translation.
privacyGemini.description: Popup footer explaining where audio goes in Gemini mode.

privacyDeepgram.message: Once started, the tab's audio is sent to Deepgram and the recognised text is sent to DeepL.
privacyDeepgram.description: Popup footer explaining where audio and text go in Deepgram mode.

settingsLoadFailed.message: Could not load settings. Please reopen the extension.
settingsLoadFailed.description: Popup error when stored settings cannot be read.

settingsSaveFailed.message: Could not save settings. Please try again.
settingsSaveFailed.description: Popup error when a setting change cannot be written.

optionsOpenFailed.message: Could not open the settings page. Choose "Options" from the extension menu instead.

captionsStopped.description: Popup confirmation after the user stops a session.

stopFailed.description: Popup error when stopping a session fails.

needGeminiKey.message: Enter your Gemini API key first. Get an API Key:
needGeminiKey.description: Popup error when starting in Gemini mode without a key.

needDeepgramAndDeeplKeys.message: Enter your Deepgram and DeepL API keys first.
needDeepgramAndDeeplKeys.description: Popup error when starting in Deepgram mode without both keys.

startFailed.message: Could not start. Check your API key and the current tab.
startFailed.description: Popup error when starting a session fails for an unknown reason.

backgroundNoResponse.message: The extension's background service did not respond
backgroundNoResponse.description: Error when a message to the service worker gets no usable reply.

needHttpsTab.message: Switch to an https tab that can play video, then start
needHttpsTab.description: Error when the active tab cannot be captioned.

needDeepgramKeyField.description: Field-level validation message for the Deepgram key.

needDeeplKeyField.description: Field-level validation message for the DeepL key.

needGeminiKeyField.description: Field-level validation message for the Gemini key.

optionsTitle.description: Heading and document title of the options page.

optionsKeyHint.message: You can clear a key and save. Only the selected provider's key is needed: Deepgram and DeepL work as a pair, Gemini live translate 3.5 works on its own.
optionsKeyHint.description: Explanation under the key fields on the options page.

saving.description: Options page submit button while a save is in flight.

keysLoadFailed.message: Could not load your API keys. Please reload and try again.
keysLoadFailed.description: Options page error when stored keys cannot be read.

keysSaved.description: Options page confirmation after a successful save.

keysSaveFailed.message: Could not save your API keys. Please try again.
keysSaveFailed.description: Options page error when a save fails.

show.description: Button that reveals a masked API key field.

hide.description: Button that masks a revealed API key field.

setApiKey.description: Button that confirms and saves an API key.

showSecret.description: Accessible name for the reveal button. $1 is the field's label.

hideSecret.description: Accessible name for the mask button. $1 is the field's label.

captionTrackLabel.description: Name of the native text track used when a video itself goes fullscreen.

errorGeminiInvalidCredentials.message: That Gemini API key was rejected. Update it on the settings page.

errorGeminiQuotaExceeded.message: Gemini quota is used up. Try later, or switch provider.

errorInvalidCredentials.message: That DeepL API key was rejected. Update it on the settings page.

errorQuotaExceeded.message: This month's DeepL translation quota is used up.

errorRateLimited.message: Too many requests to DeepL. Please wait a moment.

errorTranslationDisabled.message: DeepL failed 5 times in a row; translation is off for this session.

errorTranslationFailed.message: DeepL translation failed. The original captions continue.

errorUnknown.message: The captioning service hit an unknown error. Please restart.
errorUnknown.description: Caption overlay fallback for an unrecognised error code.

geminiConnectionTimedOut.description: Reason reported when Gemini never answers the setup message.

geminiSocketError.description: Reason reported when the Gemini socket raises an error event.

geminiApiError.description: Reason reported when Gemini sends an error frame with no message.

autoFollowAuthorizationHint.message: Open Bilingual Live Captions once to enable automatic captions on this tab
autoFollowAuthorizationHint.description: Toolbar hint shown when an active tab needs one-time authorization for caption auto-follow.

socketClosed.description: Reason reported when the socket closes without giving one. $1 is the close code.
